title: Keep candidates tidy (commercial Mandate 96), in the active contract
goal: Vision: V-21. Directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep candidates tidy. The rule lands in core's active contract after the releases rule, which it amends: one plainly named line per version, advanced by fast-forward; opened under a task and kept moving; and standing authorization to delete a line once it has ended (released, superseded or merged into a release), exactly those lines at the objects observed in one atomic push, each recorded in .agents/storage/directed-deletions.txt. Pinned in tests/architecture_tests.rs.

reuse.searched: Inside Susi: the active contract already keeps candidate lines fast-forward-only and requires recorded authorization for a deletion; docs/git-storage-publisher.md and the storage guard already accept deletions listed in .agents/storage/directed-deletions.txt; the commercial workflow candidates verb (susi-commercial-apps Mandate 96) reviews lines and retires ended ones. This amends one contract paragraph and adds one, plus one brief phrase; no new code.
